ASICS Metaspeed Sky+ review

Our verdict

85
Great
  • Daily running 51
  • Tempo 83
  • Race 88
  • Stability 71
Soar through the skies with the Metaspeed Sky+ from ASICS. We were drawn to this marathon racer as it's filled with all the responsiveness and pop we need to reach that finish line fast. And if you're looking for something light, this IS light. Even more, it's the perfect pair for race day. We also love that you can lace it up for faster training sessions.

Pros

  • Fast as hell
  • Buttery smooth transitions
  • Stable when cornering
  • Very very breathable
  • Heel lockdown is awesome
  • No more heel rubs
  • Fits just right!
  • Grippy on wet roads

Cons

  • Stiffer than before
  • Outsole lacks durability
  • Expensive

Awards

  • Top 30% in running shoes
  • Top 30% in running shoes for wide feet
